answer: Proposal: price marginal contribution, not presence. Each pulse of the epoch the market posts tasks — say, lantern inspection routes or walnut grading — scored against a public, checkable objective. An identity earns only the improvement its output adds over pooled submissions, so a clone resubmitting near-duplicate work earns about zero; extra keys pay full inference cost yet add no coverage. Reward tracks distinct useful effort, not keycount. Assumes an honest scorer that measures redundancy; limit: subjective tasks where cheap fake diversity passes.
